item.title: Middle AI/ML Engineer
item.description:
We are looking for a Middle AI/ML Engineer to develop and enhance AI-driven solutions within the Palantir Foundry and AIP ecosystem.

In this role, you will focus on building and iterating on machine learning and LLM-based solutions, integrating them into Foundry workflows to support analytics, automation, and decision-making. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, business analysts, and domain experts to deliver practical, production-ready AI solutions.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance machine learning and AI models to support predictive analytics, classification, forecasting, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Build AI and ML solutions within Palantir Foundry, using Python and existing Foundry pipelines, Ontology objects, and workflows.
  • Apply LLMs and NLP techniques (e.g. prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval-augmented workflows) using Palantir AIP for enterprise use cases.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to understand data sources, ensure data quality, and prepare datasets for model training and inference.
  • Conduct experiments, evaluate model performance, and iterate on features and model approaches.
  • Integrate AI models into Foundry workflows to surface insights and support business processes.
  • Support model deployment and monitoring by following established team standards and best practices.
  • Work closely with business and domain stakeholders to translate requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
  • Document model behavior, assumptions, and limitations to support transparency and compliance.
  • Stay up to date with applied AI and GenAI trends and contribute ideas under guidance from senior team members

 

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or applied data science.
  • Strong Python skills; experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
  • Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and retrieval strategies
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, NLP, or GenAI use cases (e.g. prompt design, embeddings, text classification, summarization).
  • Practical understanding of the ML lifecycle: data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Experience working with structured data (tabular, time series); exposure to text or unstructured data is a plus.
  • Familiarity with enterprise data environments and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to clearly explain model results and AI behavior to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher.

 

Nice to have: 

  • Proficiency in Foundry Ontology, Object Builders, and Code Repositories.
  • Experience in big pharma or highly regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, compliance, and security best practices in AI applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

 

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth

item.title: Data Scientist (automotive, telematics, gps)
item.description:
Hey! We are Kultprosvet, a team of web and mobile software developers who care. Now we’re expanding and welcome talented Telematics Data Scientist to join our team.

 

About the project:

 

This is a startup in the vision telematics space and, at its core, a data company. Its AI-powered cameras capture what’s happening on the road and inside the vehicle, while the cloud platform turns this into structured, usable insights.

The real value lies in what customers do with these insights: preventing collisions, exonerating drivers when they’re not at fault, coaching driving behaviour, strengthening their position in claims, and running leaner, more efficient operations.

The solution is built for fleets of trucks, vans, buses, and field crews across logistics, distribution, construction, field services, waste and recycling, and public transport.

With a small, agile team, the company co-develops solutions directly with customers so that the product fits their specific fleet, processes, and systems. The customers they win and the segments they open effectively shape what the company becomes and how the product evolves.

 

About the role:

 

As our Telematics Data Scientist, you’ll turn raw vehicle and sensor data into the models that power our insurance and fleet products. You’ll build sensor-based driving behaviour event detection, including calibrating sensors so events are captured accurately across vehicles and installations.

You’ll develop driver risk scoring, using classified driving behaviour to model accident frequency and severity and distil it into a score insurers and fleet managers can trust.

You’ll also build predictive models for fuel use, maintenance, total lifetime value and other high-impact use cases, taking each from first prototype through to production.

 

About you:

 

  • 4+ years of data science experience, including hands-on work with telematics data and confidence working with noisy, high-volume time-series data.
  • Solid, practical experience with GPS data is mandatory.
  • MSc or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, or engineering.
  • Ability to combine rigorous statistical and machine learning thinking with a pragmatic focus on models that perform reliably in real-world conditions.
  • Strong communication skills: you can clearly explain your work, assumptions, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ideally, knowledge and experience in motor insurance and claims analytics.

     

We’re particularly interested in candidates who match one or more of the following profiles:

 

  • Data Scientist with experience in telematics or automotive.
  • Data Scientist who has worked with geospatial / GPS data outside automotive (e.g. logistics, delivery, mapping, mobility).
  • Data Scientist from insurance (including actuaries) with strong analytics skills.
  • Strong Data Scientist with GPS experience but no automotive background — we’re open to an initial conversation.

 

What we offer:

 

  • Competitive compensation: depending on experience and qualifications;
  • Flexible work setup — remote or from our office in Dnipro.
  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical insurance, full accounting support, a budget for courses, conferences, and professional development, plus coverage for psychotherapy sessions because your well-being matters.
  • Work with cutting-edge telematics and vision AI: you’ll turn raw vehicle and sensor data into models that power real-world insurance and fleet products (risk scoring, fuel and maintenance prediction, lifetime value, and other high-impact use cases).
  • Direct influence on the core product: in a smaller, fast-moving team, the models and solutions you build will go straight into production and be used by insurers and fleet managers.
  • Customer-driven development: you’ll co-develop solutions with customers who run trucks, vans, buses, and crews across logistics, distribution, construction, field services, waste & recycling, and public transport, so your work is tightly tied to real use cases.
  • Startup environment with short decision lines: as a disruptor in vision telematics, the customers and segments you help win and open directly shape the direction of the company.
  • End-to-end ownership: you’ll take solutions from first prototype through to production for sensor-based driving behaviour event detection (including sensor calibration), driver risk scoring, and predictive models for fuel use, maintenance, and total lifetime value.

 

💡 Ready to work on meaningful products and grow with us? Let’s connect! 🚀

item.title: Інженер із машинного навчання / Machine Learning Engineer
item.description:
Slidom — платформа для моніторингу транспорту та управління автопарком. Шукаємо в команду інженера з машинного навчання, який допоможе створювати нові інтелектуальні функції продукту.
У нас є реальні дані та практичні задачі. Потрібна людина, яка зможе розібратися в них, запропонувати підхід, навчити модель і разом із розробниками впровадити її в продукт.
Що потрібно буде робити
 

  • Аналізувати дані, знаходити закономірності та готувати їх для навчання моделей.
  • Розробляти й навчати моделі машинного навчання.
  • Перевіряти, наскільки добре вони працюють на реальних даних.
  • Працювати з неповними даними, помилками та неточностями в них.
  • Разом із командою впроваджувати рішення в продукт і покращувати їх.

Що для нас важливо
 

  • Практичний досвід у машинному навчанні — від підготовки даних до оцінки результату.
  • Впевнене знання Python та бібліотек для аналізу даних і машинного навчання.
  • Знання SQL.
  • Розуміння статистики та способів перевірки якості моделей.
  • Вміння самостійно досліджувати задачу й пояснювати свої рішення команді.

Буде плюсом досвід роботи з геоданими, часовими рядами або транспортною телематикою, а також досвід впровадження моделей у реальному продукті.
Що пропонуємо
 

  • Роботу над власним продуктом, де ваші рішення використовуватимуть клієнти.
  • Можливість впливати на підходи та вибір технологій.
  • Пряму взаємодію з командою розробки.
  • Формат співпраці та оплату, які обговоримо під час знайомства.

Детальніше про задачі розповімо на співбесіді після підписання угоди про нерозголошення.
Надішліть резюме та кілька слів про ваші проєкти: що саме ви робили та якого результату вдалося досягти.

Відгуки без супровідного листа не розглядаються. Просимо додати короткий супровідний лист до відгуку на вакансію.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist
item.description:
Join Sigma Software to help build advanced machine learning solutions for one of the large-scale players in the programmatic advertising ecosystem. 

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with strong production ML expertise and deep interest in real-time optimization systems, large-scale behavioral data, and AdTech challenges.

In this role, you will work with a dedicated Sigma Software team on a predictive modeling platform integrated with a live ad exchange processing hundreds of millions of auction requests daily. You will contribute to sophisticated ML solutions involving bid optimization, calibration, counterfactual evaluation, and constrained decision-making systems.

 

We as a company offer the opportunity to work on technically challenging products, collaborate with experienced engineers and data scientists, and make a direct impact on large-scale production systems.

 

CUSTOMER

Our Customer is a technology company operating supply-side infrastructure within the programmatic advertising ecosystem. The company manages a high-scale ad exchange platform and is investing in predictive decisioning capabilities to improve advertising performance, audience targeting, and campaign optimization through advanced machine learning technologies.

 

PROJECT

The project focuses on building a predictive modeling and optimization platform on top of a live ad exchange environment. The platform evaluates and filters advertising supply in real time, predicts high-performing audience contexts, builds look-alike audiences from small seed datasets, and optimizes campaign performance across multiple business objectives and operational constraints.

The team works on complex machine learning challenges including censored bid-landscape modeling, sparse and delayed conversion attribution, calibration systems, counterfactual evaluation, and constrained optimization models. The solution is designed for large-scale production use and close collaboration with the Customer’s internal data science organization.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and improve censored bid-landscape models to estimate clearing-price distributions from partially observed auction data
  •  Develop real-time win probability estimation models responsive to bid pricing dynamics
  • Design and implement hierarchical lift estimation models with confidence-bound-based selection strategies
  • Build conversion propensity models using sparse, delayed, and aggregate-only labels
  • Develop look-alike audience modeling approaches using positive-unlabeled learning and embedding-based nearest-neighbor techniques
  • Implement advertiser-level calibration strategies while independently monitoring ranking and calibration quality
  • Design robust offline evaluation frameworks using inverse-propensity scoring, doubly-robust estimators, and importance reweighting
  • Define exploration strategies and propensity logging approaches to ensure reliable downstream correction and evaluation
  • Develop constrained optimization mechanisms for campaign objectives, pricing constraints, and volume targeting
  • Contribute to data diagnostics, capability assessments, and evidence-based model recommendations
  • Collaborate with the Customer team during post-launch tuning and performance validation cycles
  • Prepare technical documentation and knowledge transfer materials for the Customer’s internal data science team
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to scalable ML platform design decisions

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning or Data Science with production-grade models measured against business KPIs
  • Strong Python skills including numpy, pandas, and scikit-learn
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets
  • Deep practical experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost
  • Strong understanding of regularization, calibration methods, and categorical feature handling
  • Strong knowledge of probability, statistics, confidence intervals, and statistical power analysis
  • Experience with feature engineering for structured and behavioral datasets
  • Hands-on experience with Spark or PySpark
  • Practical knowledge of experimentation frameworks and A/B testing methodologies
  • Experience with advanced validation approaches including temporal splits, leakage detection, drift analysis, and slice-based metrics
  • Understanding of explainability techniques such as SHAP and permutation importance
  • Upper-Intermediate English level or higher

 

WILL BE A PLUS

  • Experience in AdTech modeling including CTR/CVR prediction, bid-landscape modeling, audience segmentation, and RTB mechanics
  • Experience working with sparse, delayed, or censored labels
  • Knowledge of attribution modeling, survival analysis, and positive-unlabeled learning
  • Practical experience with counterfactual and off-policy evaluation techniques
  • Understanding of calibration methods including isotonic regression and Platt scaling
  • Experience with hierarchical, empirical-Bayes, or partial-pooling models
  • Knowledge of constrained or multi-objective optimization approaches
  • Experience with uplift modeling and causal inference methods
  • Experience with Vertex AI or similar managed ML training environments
  • Publications, competitive modeling achievements, or open-source contributions related to Machine Learning or AdTech

 

PERSONAL PROFILE

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly data-driven environment
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Ability to explain complex modeling decisions to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proactive mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Attention to detail and scientific rigor in experimentation and evaluation

item.description:
Quantitative Research Engineer / Quantitative Researcher / Quant Developer / Algorithmic Trading Researcher / Machine Learning Engineer for Financial Markets

Remote project-based work / development of a quantitative research & prediction system

Relevant areas of experience:

Quantitative Research / Quant Development / Algorithmic Trading / Machine Learning for Financial Markets / Time-Series Research / Trading Systems Development / Systematic Trading / Quantitative Trading

 

We are looking for an individual specialist / a team of specialists / a specialized company to develop a system for forecasting intraday movements of U.S. stocks listed on the NYSE and NASDAQ.

The system's primary objective is to use historical and current market data to identify stocks with an elevated probability of a persistent, sufficiently strong, and relatively smooth directional LONG or SHORT move within a specified future time window.

We are not simply looking to predict whether the final price will be above or below the starting price. We are interested in the quality of the price path: predominantly one-directional movement without significant adverse moves, repeated reversals, or chaotic price action.

The system must distinguish between:

LONG — a high-quality directional move upward;
SHORT — a high-quality directional move downward;
NO_TREND — the absence of a sufficiently high-quality directional move.

Truth

We already have our own methodology for defining LONG / SHORT / NO_TREND.

At the first stage, it will be provided to the contractor for an independent methodological review, discussion, and final agreement.

Once agreed, the Truth methodology is frozen and must not be changed to fit the results of a specific model or the final TEST/HOLDOUT.

Final Project Goal

In production mode, the system must analyze the stock universe on a daily basis and select

5 to 10 of the most promising stocks with a LONG or SHORT forecast.

 

Primary target KPI:

average monthly accuracy of 40%+ among the signals actually selected by the system.

In other words, over the course of a month, at least 40% of all evaluated LONG/SHORT forecasts actually selected by the system for use must match the pre-defined Truth.

The prediction time and the future prediction horizon must be configurable system parameters.

In real-time mode, a forecast is generated at time τ, and its actual outcome is evaluated after the corresponding horizon H has elapsed, using the same Truth methodology.

The specific statistical / ML methods and the model's internal architecture are not prescribed by the client in advance.

Example of the Type of Movement We Are Looking For

Real intraday candlestick charts are included in the project description.

 

 

 

Collaboration and Compensation

Our primary focus is on results, rather than hourly billing.

The first key threshold is confirmed forecast accuracy of at least 35% under an agreed validation protocol, with no look-ahead, data leakage, or fitting to the control data.

The result will be evaluated on a pre-defined independent period and/or in live/paper-trading mode using the agreed Truth methodology.

The target operating mode is 5–10 selected LONG/SHORT forecasts per trading day.

A separate bonus is provided for achieving confirmed accuracy of 35%+ under the agreed methodology.

The final target is average forecast accuracy of 40%+ per calendar month, with a sufficient number of evaluated signals.

After the 35% level has been confirmed, we are ready to discuss one or a combination of several collaboration models:

Performance-based compensation. As a guideline — from USD 100 for each correctly evaluated forecast, subject to pre-agreed rules regarding the maximum number of signals, accuracy, Truth, and the method used to calculate results.

License / subscription — recurring payment for continuous access to the system or daily forecasts. Ownership of the software may remain with the contractor.

System buyout — transfer to the client of full rights to the software and all required components: source code, data pipeline, prediction/research pipeline, configurations, documentation, and instructions for independent operation and further development.

To apply:

Please send a short note including:

Your experience

Your general approach (you do not need to disclose your algorithms)

When you would be available to start working on the project
Project-based, performance-oriented compensation; the final format and budget are agreed individually.

You will play a pivotal role in crafting innovative data solutions, supporting sales efforts, and delivering exceptional value to our clients through strategic consulting and technical expertise.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a tangible impact across global industries.

  • Work closely with sales, delivery, and expert teams to align client needs with data-driven solutions, effectively connecting business challenges to our offerings

  • Lead workshops and meetings with clients to gather business objectives and technical requirements, ensuring alignment between client goals and our solutions
  • Architect tailored data solutions, encompassing cloud-native platforms, data integration, advanced analytics, and AI/ML models, to provide actionable business insights
  • Develop competitive proposals, pricing models, and value propositions to successfully close opportunities and secure engagements

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills—able to translate complex technical concepts into clear, client-friendly narratives
  • Proven track record in engagement with senior stakeholders and delivery of impactful presentations or pitches
  • Experience in creation of detailed proposals, RFP responses, and pricing/engagement models for data-related services or projects
  • Understanding of strategic consulting principles and the ability to develop future-state recommendations and roadmaps for client success
  • Strong organizational, leadership, and project scoping abilities, with a proven ability to manage complex tasks in a fast-paced environment

We offer/Benefits

  • Receive the necessary equipment to perform your work tasks
  • Change projects and technology stacks within EPAM
  • Gain experience in various business domains (Insurance, E-commerce, Healthcare, Finance, Travelling, Media, Artificial Intelligence, and more)
  • Relocation opportunities may be available for eligible candidates, depending on the role and openings at other EPAM locations
  • Participate in volunteer, charity programs and communities (both technical and interest-based)

We focus on your professional growth:

  • You can plan your individual career path together with your manager
  • Receive regular feedback from colleagues
  • Improve your English for free with certified teachers (Speaking Clubs, client interview preparation courses, etc.)
  • Get the opportunity to undergo free training and certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure Clouds

  • Develop as a leader, join Delivery Management, Resource Management, Leadership Essentials school and more

What we offer:

item.title: Head of MDM/Data Architecture
item.description:
Шукаємо Head of MDM & Data Architecture, який стане власником платформи. Ця людина відповідатиме за архітектуру та інтеграції, запустить перші домени (номенклатура й контрагенти) і масштабує рішення на всі 10. Це не короткий проєкт. Це можливість створити й розвивати ключову data-платформу компанії, впливати на вибір рішення і працювати разом із командами Data, IT, AI та бізнесу. 

 

Обов’язки: 

Управління MDM-системою (System Owner) 

- Управління повним життєвим циклом MDM-системи: від вимог до промислової експлуатації та розвитку. 

- Визначення цільової архітектури MDM і її узгодження з корпоративною архітектурою. 

- Формування дорожньої карти розвитку системи, планування та контроль бюджету. 

- Управління доступами, ролями та безпекою даних у системі. 

- Забезпечення безперервної роботи системи та дотримання SLA. 
 

Управління майстер-даними 

- Проєктування та розвиток моделей даних довідників. 

- Забезпечення гнучкої зміни структури довідників. 

- Налаштування та розвиток процесів (WorkFlow) створення і зміни записів. 

 

Завантаження даних та Golden Records 

- Організація масового завантаження і оновлення даних (ETL). 

- Забезпечення перевірки даних до завантаження та контролю помилок. 

- Визначення правил формування Golden Record (match & merge, survivorship). 

- Визначення правил поширення еталонних даних у компанії. 

 

Інтеграція 

- Участь у побудові централізованої інтеграції MDM через єдину шину замість обміну «точка-точка». 

- Підключення нових систем-споживачів і джерел даних (ERP, TMS, PLM, HR, EntraID тощо). 

- Контроль стабільності обміну даними між системами. 

 

Управління командою та підрядниками 

- Керівництво відділом: постановка задач, розподіл ресурсів, розвиток компетенцій. 

- Координація роботи вендора, інтегратора та внутрішніх розробників. 

- Приймання робіт та контроль якості і термінів. 

- Впровадження та розвиток 

- Організація тестування (функціонального, інтеграційного, UAT). 

- Навчання користувачів і data stewards, підготовка інструкцій. 

- Запуск і тиражування системи. 

 

Кого ми шукаємо: 

- Від 5 років досвіду в управлінні даними або впровадженні корпоративних систем. З них від 2–3 років саме в MDM. 

- Підтверджений досвід хоча б одного повного проєкту впровадження MDM, від вимог до промислової експлуатації. Підходить власна розробка або платформа: Semarchy, Informatica MDM, TIBCO, IBM MDM, Profisee, CluedIn, Stibo STEP, SAP MDG, Reltio, Ataccama тощо. 

- Розуміння архітектури MDM: стилі впровадження (registry, consolidation, coexistence, centralized), моделювання даних, match & merge, survivorship, Golden Record, data stewardship. 

- Розуміння інтеграційних підходів (ESB, REST/SOAP API, брокери на кшталт Kafka або RabbitMQ) і ETL-інструментів. 

- Впевнене знання SQL і реляційних БД. 

- Досвід роботи з вендорами та інтеграторами: постановка задач, приймання робіт, контроль SLA. 

- Досвід керування командою або проєктною командою. 

- Англійська від B2: документація, комунікація з вендором. 

 

Випробувальний термін 3 місяці за цей час: 

Перші 3 міс.  

1) Kick-off проєкту (старт орієнтовно в середині грудня), розроблений план впровадження, якісний старт впровадження MDM.  

2) Налагоджена ефективна робота з інтегратором / провайдером сервісу. 

 
6–12 місяців  

Базове впровадження MDM-системи, налаштування конфігурацій під специфічні бізнес-процеси по довідниках. Перші впровадження: номенклатура та контрагенти.  

 

Далі  

Тиражування на решту доменів, підтримка й розвиток системи, зростання команди.  

 

Відгукується? Надсилайте резюме, із задоволенням познайомимося!

item.title: Data Engineer
item.description:
Department/Project Description

The project focuses on developing and modernizing a global data platform that supports data-driven marketing and advertising analytics for a leading international company.
The goal is to improve data quality, scalability, performance, and the reliability of data processing.


Job Description

  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Compute Engine, and Monitoring.
     AWS or Azure experiecne could be also considered.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including experience in building, testing, and deploying ETL/ELT pipelines in production
     Experience developing data quality frameworks, including automated tests, cross-dataset validations, and anomaly detection across diverse data assets
  • Advanced SQL skills, including data modeling (star/snowflake/3NF), optimization, and writing performant queries tailored to BigQuery’s slot-based execution model
  • Solid working knowledge of DBT, including incremental models, testing, documentation, and advanced features like custom macros
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize BigQuery workloads through partitioning, clustering, materialized views, and cost-aware development practices
  • Experience working with ETL orchestration tools, ideally Cloud Composer or similar frameworks (Kestra, Dagster, etc.).
     Hands-on experience consuming and managing APIs for data extraction.
  •  Exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices, including ticket triage, incident management, and documenting runbooks/SOPs
  • Familiar with Git and modern software development workflows, including pull requests and code reviews
  • Comfortable working in an agile team environment, with the ability to multitask and reprioritize based on changing project needs
  • English speaking and writing B2+, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
     

Job Responsibilities

  •  Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable data pipelines using Python,SQL, DBT, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services like BigQuery and Cloud Composer.
  • Contributing to the development and evolution of our data quality framework, ensuring robust automated testing and cross-dataset validation across all critical data assets
  • Writing and optimizing advanced SQL to power data models, analytics, and reporting pipelines, with a focus on performance and efficiency within BigQuery
  • Developing and maintaining DBT models, including testing, documentation, incremental loading strategies, and the creation of reusable macros
  • Supporting day-to-day incident and ticket resolution, including root cause analysis and documentation of runbooks/SOPs to drive platform reliability
  • Working with APIs and external data sources to extract, normalize, and integrate new datasets into the platform
  • Participating in agile ceremonies (stand-ups, retros, planning), contributing to sprint goals and helping support the wider team objectives
  • Actively contributing to code reviews, documentation, and peer learning - helping to raise engineering standards and share knowledge within the team
  • Monitoring system health and pipeline performance using GCP-native tools and dashboards, and proactively identifying opportunities for cost or performance optimization

item.title: Lead Data Scientist_TT
item.description:
We're looking for a Lead Data Scientist to join a fast-growing, privacy-preserving data collaboration fintech as second-in-command to the Head of Data Science. You'll own the analytical roadmap and the delivery of client analytics, write production-grade code every day, and mentor a growing team through a move to a modern Python and lakehouse stack with AI-first workflows.


Logistics

  • Location: fully remote, living in Europe or South Africa
  • Working hours: South Africa time zone (UTC+2)
  • Travel: occasional in-person meetings in Johannesburg or Cape Town
  • Employment: permanent, full-time

  • Seniority: Mid-Senior / Lead

     

About the company

The company is a Series A fintech backed by a global credit bureau and a major retailer. It was founded in South Africa and has teams in South Africa, the UK, the US, the UAE and Brazil. Banks, insurers and lenders use its platform to get insight from retailer and telco data without exposing individual identities. One example is helping people with no credit history get access to credit. Data science is central to the product: privacy-preserving models, entity resolution, data linkage and AI-augmented pipelines.


What you'll do

  • Own the analytical roadmap and end-to-end client analytics delivery. You'll frame the problem, set success criteria, run the analysis and present to senior stakeholders, including saying so when the evidence doesn't support the client's expected conclusion.
  • Write production-grade, testable Python.
  • Mentor data scientists and, if it fits, lead an Agile squad.
  • Drive the move from SQL, Azure Synapse and Power BI to Python, Jupyter, PySpark and Delta Lake, using Claude Code and agentic workflows.

 

Stack: PySpark, Delta Lake, Jupyter, Azure Synapse, T-SQL, Trino, Power BI, scikit-learn, Kubernetes model serving, FastAPI inference endpoints.

 

What we expect

  • 7+ years across data science, analytics or data warehousing, with substantial recent hands-on DS.
  • ML and statistical models you've taken to production yourself: deploying, monitoring and retraining.
  • Advanced Python (Jupyter, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and production-grade code.
  • Warehouse SQL and BI: Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, T-SQL and/or ANSI SQL, plus Power BI or Python visualisation.
  • Lakehouse experience: Delta Lake or similar, PySpark, feature stores, training-data versioning, schema evolution.
  • 2+ years of technical leadership: mentoring, owning delivery and communicating with senior stakeholders while staying hands-on.
  • STEM degree or equivalent experience, and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable working South Africa hours (UTC+2).

 

Strong advantages

  • Credit risk and scorecards (PD/LGD, application or behavioural scorecards) at a bank, lender or credit bureau.
  • Retail or loyalty analytics: basket, SKU or loyalty data, customer analytics, precision marketing.
  • Client-facing delivery, for example in a data science consultancy.
  • Multi-party or privacy-sensitive data: entity resolution, record linkage, clean rooms, matched or aggregated data.
  • FastAPI, pytest, Kubernetes model serving, data governance, PySpark at scale.
  • Already using Claude Code or other agentic tools in research, prototyping and production.
  • C#/.NET, Angular or Electron.

 

Why this role

  • Real influence: you're the deputy to the Head of DS, with a seat at the table on roadmap and delivery.
  • Data science is the core of the product, not a support function.
  • A chance to shape a modernisation of the stack and an AI-first way of working.
  • Meaningful impact: bringing credit access to people without a credit history.
  • Fully remote, with a globally distributed team.

item.title: Middle Data Scientist

Основні задачі:
 

  • Побудова, навчання та валідація ML-моделей (класифікація, регресія, кластеризація) для вирішення бізнес-задач компанії.

  • Проведення дослідницького аналізу даних (EDA), пошук закономірностей та формування гіпотез.
  • Аналіз ефективності моделей, оцінка їх якості за допомогою релевантних метрик та інтерпретація результатів.
  • Підтримка, моніторинг та вдосконалення моделей, що працюють у production.
  • Оптимізація існуючих моделей та участь у впровадженні нових ML-рішень.
  • Співпраця з командами аналітики, розробки та бізнесу для реалізації data-driven рішень.

item.title: Data Scientist, Machine Learning
item.description:
Rx360 is building a wearable and AI companion that helps seniors live independently and stay connected to the people who care about them. Our mission is to give older adults confidence in their everyday lives, and to give their families peace of mind.
Our team works across hardware, firmware, software and AI. We move quickly, care deeply about the people we build for, and hold a high bar for quality and trust.
We're looking for a Data Scientist to turn what our wearable senses into intelligence that keeps seniors safe. You'll build the machine learning behind fall detection and fall-risk prediction, and the health and activity insights our AI companion shares with seniors and their supporters. You'll own models from raw sensor data and labels through validation and deployment, on the band and in the cloud.


What You Will Do
• Build and own ML models for fall detection on the Rx360 band, using IMU, barometer and PPG signals, with high sensitivity and very few false alarms
• Develop fall-risk and fall-prevention models that spot changes in gait, activity, sleep and heart rate over days and weeks, so supporters can act before a fall happens
• Build our datasets from real-world wear by older adults, including data collection, labeling and ground-truth processes with pilot and clinical partners
• Design validation plans and success metrics, such as sensitivity, false alarms per wearer-day and time to alert, and run validation studies in pilots
• Work with firmware engineers to run models on the band within tight memory, compute and battery limits, through feature design, model compression and quantization
• Define the sensor data we capture and how it flows from band to cloud, and build the pipelines and tooling that keep it clean, labeled and usable for training
• Turn sensor data into everyday insights, such as steps, activity, sleep, heart rate trends, wear time and anomalies, for our AI companion and supporter app
• Monitor model performance in the field, investigate misses and false alarms, and retrain and improve models over time
• Partner with product, hardware, firmware, software, clinical and AI teams to shape requirements and decide what to build next
• Handle health data responsibly, with privacy, consent and security built into how we collect, store and use it
• Communicate results, trade-offs and risks clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues


What You'll Bring
• 5+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, including models shipped to production

• Required: at least 2 hours of overlap each day with U.S. Central time (CT) working hours to collaborate with our U.S. team
• Hands-on experience with time-series sensor data, such as accelerometer, gyroscope or PPG, including signal processing and feature engineering
• Strong Python and experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, along with classical ML methods
• Experience with rare-event problems and imbalanced data, and sound judgment on evaluation, error analysis and the cost of false alarms versus misses
• Experience deploying models to resource-constrained or embedded devices, or working closely with firmware engineers to do so
• Experience designing data collection and labeling, and building data pipelines (SQL, cloud data tools)
• Excellent written and spoken English
• Comfort working remotely and asynchronously across time zones
• Curiosity, persistence and a bias for action
• Empathy for older adults and the people who care for them


Nice to Have
• Background in digital health, wearables or connected medical devices, including clinical validation studies
• Experience with on-device ML tools such as TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers or Edge Impulse
• Familiarity with health data privacy and regulatory requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, FDA or MDR)
• Startup experience through early launches
How to Apply
Send your CV, a short note about a model you took from raw sensor or real-world data to production and what you learned along the way, and a sample of your work (a repo, notebook, paper or write-up, redacted if needed).
Rx360 is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist
item.description:
Join Sigma Software to help build advanced machine learning solutions for one of the large-scale players in the programmatic advertising ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with strong production ML expertise and deep interest in real-time optimization systems, large-scale behavioral data, and AdTech challenges.

In this role, you will work with a dedicated Sigma Software team on a predictive modeling platform integrated with a live ad exchange processing hundreds of millions of auction requests daily. You will contribute to sophisticated ML solutions involving bid optimization, calibration, counterfactual evaluation, and constrained decision-making systems.

We as a company offer the opportunity to work on technically challenging products, collaborate with experienced engineers and data scientists, and make a direct impact on large-scale production systems.

 

CUSTOMER

Our Customer is a technology company operating supply-side infrastructure within the programmatic advertising ecosystem. The company manages a high-scale ad exchange platform and is investing in predictive decisioning capabilities to improve advertising performance, audience targeting, and campaign optimization through advanced machine learning technologies.

 

PROJECT

The project focuses on building a predictive modeling and optimization platform on top of a live ad exchange environment. The platform evaluates and filters advertising supply in real time, predicts high-performing audience contexts, builds look-alike audiences from small seed datasets, and optimizes campaign performance across multiple business objectives and operational constraints.

The team works on complex machine learning challenges including censored bid-landscape modeling, sparse and delayed conversion attribution, calibration systems, counterfactual evaluation, and constrained optimization models. The solution is designed for large-scale production use and close collaboration with the Customer’s internal data science organization.

 

Job Description

 

  • Build and improve censored bid-landscape models to estimate clearing-price distributions from partially observed auction data
  •  Develop real-time win probability estimation models responsive to bid pricing dynamics
  • Design and implement hierarchical lift estimation models with confidence-bound-based selection strategies
  • Build conversion propensity models using sparse, delayed, and aggregate-only labels
  • Develop look-alike audience modeling approaches using positive-unlabeled learning and embedding-based nearest-neighbor techniques
  • Implement advertiser-level calibration strategies while independently monitoring ranking and calibration quality
  • Design robust offline evaluation frameworks using inverse-propensity scoring, doubly-robust estimators, and importance reweighting
  • Define exploration strategies and propensity logging approaches to ensure reliable downstream correction and evaluation
  • Develop constrained optimization mechanisms for campaign objectives, pricing constraints, and volume targeting
  • Contribute to data diagnostics, capability assessments, and evidence-based model recommendations
  • Collaborate with the Customer team during post-launch tuning and performance validation cycles
  • Prepare technical documentation and knowledge transfer materials for the Customer’s internal data science team
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to scalable ML platform design decisions

 

Qualifications

 

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning or Data Science with production-grade models measured against business KPIs
  • Strong Python skills including numpy, pandas, and scikit-learn
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets
  • Deep practical experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost
  • Strong understanding of regularization, calibration methods, and categorical feature handling
  • Strong knowledge of probability, statistics, confidence intervals, and statistical power analysis
  • Experience with feature engineering for structured and behavioral datasets
  • Hands-on experience with Spark or PySpark
  • Practical knowledge of experimentation frameworks and A/B testing methodologies
  • Experience with advanced validation approaches including temporal splits, leakage detection, drift analysis, and slice-based metrics
  • Understanding of explainability techniques such as SHAP and permutation importance
  • Upper-Intermediate English level or higher

 

WILL BE A PLUS

  • Experience in AdTech modeling including CTR/CVR prediction, bid-landscape modeling, audience segmentation, and RTB mechanics
  • Experience working with sparse, delayed, or censored labels
  • Knowledge of attribution modeling, survival analysis, and positive-unlabeled learning
  • Practical experience with counterfactual and off-policy evaluation techniques
  • Understanding of calibration methods including isotonic regression and Platt scaling
  • Experience with hierarchical, empirical-Bayes, or partial-pooling models
  • Knowledge of constrained or multi-objective optimization approaches
  • Experience with uplift modeling and causal inference methods
  • Experience with Vertex AI or similar managed ML training environments
  • Publications, competitive modeling achievements, or open-source contributions related to Machine Learning or AdTech

 

PERSONAL PROFILE

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly data-driven environment
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Ability to explain complex modeling decisions to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proactive mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Attention to detail and scientific rigor in experimentation and evaluation

item.title: Data Science Tech Lead
item.description:
Це hands-on Tech Lead роль із фокусом на мультимодальні рішення. Найближчі продуктові виклики переважно пов’язані з Computer Vision і відео, однак нам важливо, щоб людина могла занурюватися в задачі всіх AI-напрямів, оцінювати технічні підходи та допомагати команді знаходити оптимальні рішення.

 

Основні задачі

  • Формувати технічні підходи до мультимодальних AI-рішень.
  • Допомагати спеціалістам із напрямів відео, аудіо та тексту вирішувати складні дослідницькі й продуктові задачі.
  • Проводити технічні рев’ю, брати участь у брейнштормах і пропонувати альтернативні підходи.
  • Визначати, коли варто використовувати готові моделі та зовнішні AI-сервіси, а коли — розробляти, fine-tune або оптимізувати власні моделі.
  • Розвивати архітектурні та інструментальні підходи до MLOps.
  • Працювати разом із продуктовими й інженерними командами — від перевірки гіпотез до запуску рішень у production.

 

Що важливо

  • 5+ років комерційного досвіду в Data Science або Machine Learning.
  • Широкий практичний досвід із сучасними ML- і deep learning-підходами.
  • Досвід роботи щонайменше з кількома модальностями: відео, зображеннями, аудіо або текстом.
  • Розуміння принципів побудови мультимодальних систем і взаємодії моделей різних типів.
  • Сильна експертиза хоча б в одному AI-напрямі та здатність швидко занурюватися в інші.
  • Досвід технічного лідерства: проєктування рішень, рев’ю підходів, менторинг і підтримка спеціалістів.
  • Практичний досвід навчання, fine-tuning, оцінювання та оптимізації моделей.
  • Уміння обирати між власною розробкою, open-source-моделями та зовнішніми AI-сервісами.
  • Впевнене володіння Python та PyTorch або TensorFlow.
  • Досвід запуску й підтримки ML-рішень у production.
  • Розуміння MLOps: керування експериментами, версіонування, deployment, моніторинг і масштабування моделей.
  • Сильна база в машинному навчанні, математичній статистиці та оцінюванні якості моделей.
  • Уміння аргументовано оцінювати технічні компроміси й ухвалювати рішення в умовах невизначеності.

 

Буде перевагою

  • Досвід із Computer Vision та обробкою відео.
  • Роботу з multimodal-моделями, які поєднують відео, зображення, аудіо й текст.
  • Досвід з audio ML: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice cloning або аудіогенерацією.
  • Роботу з генеративними моделями для створення відео чи аудіоконтенту.
  • Досвід побудови ML-платформ або MLOps-процесів на рівні команди чи компанії.

 

Що пропонуємо

  • Різнопланові задачі на перетині відео, аудіо, тексту та Generative AI.
  • Можливість впливати на технічну стратегію AI-напряму.
  • Простір для дослідження сучасних моделей і впровадження їх у реальний продукт.

Our team of 150+ specialists operates globally, with Warsaw as our main hub office. We are driven by continuous improvement and a people-first culture where we communicate openly, win together, and truly enjoy the game we’re building.
We operate under an MGA B2B Critical Supply License and certifications from iTechLabs and GLI, ensuring our products meet high standards of quality, compliance, and performance across markets.

We are looking for a Game Mathematician to create, calibrate, deeply tune, and validate mathematical models for our slot games. We are scaling our mathematical department to transition to a dedicated structure, assigning one dedicated mathematician to each of our game streams. 

Responsibilities

  • Develop and design mathematical models for slot games from initial concept to release
  • Collaborate closely with Game Producers to refine, balance, and tune game concepts
  • Validate, simulate (alongside simulation developers), and sign off on mathematical models to ensure they perform strictly as intended
  • Troubleshoot with engineers on the precise technical implementation and integration of math models
  • Maintain structured documentation and records of game math files, configurations, and simulation benchmarks
  • Provide expert math support and clear explanations for game designers, engineers, compliance, and other internal teams
  • Deliver early feedback and predictions on player engagement based on the game's mathematical profile
  • Design and propose original features and mathematical solutions for diverse game mechanics
  • Analyze BI performance data of live games to continuously tune and optimize mechanics based on real metrics
  • Mentor and support junior team members, guiding them through technical decisions during math creation

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of practical commercial experience creating mathematical models specifically for slot games (experience in game providers, dedicated slot studios, or outsource)
  • Deep knowledge of probability theory, combinatorics, RTP calculation, volatility, and mechanics balancing
  • Proficiency in specialized mathematical modeling tools, simulation software, and working with math files
  • Hands-on experience with Python and C# for calculations and simulations
  • Experience working with BI analytics to evaluate product performance
  • Perfectionism and strong attention to detail: a drive to bring models to perfection, deeply tune, and polish the math
  • High level of autonomy with the ability to conduct calculations and manage your workflow independently without micromanagement
  • Solid communication skills for regular dialogue with the Game Producer and the wider team

Benefits

  • 7-hour working day, 10:00 AM—6:00 PM, including a lunch break
  • A-class office in Mokotów, Warsaw
  • Competitive salary in the IT field, with taxes paid
  • 10 days of paid sick leave
  • 28 days of paid vacation: 18 days plus 10 additional days separately
  • Paid state holidays
  • Medical insurance
  • Courses and training reimbursement
  • Referral bonus for bringing talented people to the team
  • Corporate English courses: business or general English, with morning and evening schedules
  • People-oriented company with a focus on work-life balance
  • Open and friendly communication
  • Corporate team-building events and activities


Please note that feedback on your application will be provided within two weeks if a positive decision is made regarding your candidacy.
